verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a centralized rule system to define and enforce engineering standards. Governance is described as enforcing consistent standards across every repository automatically, and Rule Miner generates rules from PR history. Rules and standards are also retrievable for review via the CLI and Agentic Toolbox. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of the rule formats (natural-language rules, AST patterns, linked style guides), detail on how custom rules surface as review findings, and independent or hands-on corroboration of enforcement.
